crossRefs.note: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make, and I will spare them, as a man…
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

translations.bsb: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
translations.kjv: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
translations.asv: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.
